description: Detects and eliminates AI-slop from text, prose, and image prompts using a 76-rule structural pattern corpus, a 237-term tiered ban lexicon, and an image-slop negative-prompt pack, with a slopcheck.py linter for scan, calibrate, and allowlist workflows. Activates on: de-slop this, deslop, anti-slop, AI slop, sounds like AI, reads like ChatGPT, AI tells, humanize this, make this sound human, remove AI words, overused AI words, banned words check, slop scan, slopcheck, cliché check, AI writing check, delve, tapestry, em-dash overuse, negative parallelism, it's not X it's Y, image slop, negative prompts for AI images, calibrate slop thresholds, refresh the slop list. Also applies silently as writing constraints when drafting outward-facing prose — blog posts, LinkedIn, newsletters, docs, marketing copy. NOT for attributing third-party text to AI (no authorship claims) and NOT for icon slop (use purging-icon-slop).
